### Ruby Tuesday Selects Toast to Drive Its Next Chapter


11/05/2026


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Toast (NYSE:TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced an agreement with[Ruby Tuesday](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rubytuesday.com%2F&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Ruby+Tuesday&index=1&md5=f4688d509f214b55c72d245aed960fb2) , a leading casual American bar and grill chain, to implement Toast enterprise technology across Ruby Tuesday restaurants systemwide.


Ruby Tuesday selected Toast because of its ability to help them evolve the technology experience for their employees and guests. It will leverage[Toast Go® 3](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Ftoast-go%3Fsrsltid%3DAU7gw4Xb_aE-WLJu1RSpL2Tb_VrVC7zivzqVySym4B91jAe-Jzx9E65m&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Go%26%23174%3B+3&index=2&md5=b9b987cf91dfad752abebc83a38b3af3) handhelds,[Toast Flex 3 terminals](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Ftoast-flex%3Fsrsltid%3DAU7gw4WUDl-u3yywzvVNVW7qL1IkCzBPJfMcdD41J8VMEY2QFTS2Ugus&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Flex+3+terminals&index=3&md5=96bd8c7efe2075fe08428a3fc48d4513) , and[Toast Kitchen Display Systems](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Fkitchen-display-system%3Fsrsltid%3DAU7gw4W1jq-yKizysL5mder4rMiz0tgkMsrQEKAuQJirTlId0x1hbjL9&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Kitchen+Display+Systems&index=4&md5=ca342fb22f3880171a3fad808a2e7d0b) (KDS), in addition to[Toast Payment Processing](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fproducts%2Fpayments&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Payment+Processing&index=5&md5=1018462963ffcb2b7e5f76ea271669db) to help them deliver the outstanding service and uncompromising quality that defines their hospitality. The introduction of[Toast Go® 3](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Ftoast-go%3Fsrsltid%3DAU7gw4Xb_aE-WLJu1RSpL2Tb_VrVC7zivzqVySym4B91jAe-Jzx9E65m&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Go%26%23174%3B+3&index=6&md5=5b2057e3760903d918e31f1dd83816d0) handhelds, in particular, will help support order accuracy and efficiency at Ruby Tuesday, allowing the team to focus on the neighborhood comfort and gracious hospitality the brand is known for.


“At Ruby Tuesday, authentic hospitality and commitment to our guests has always been at the heart of what we do,” said Kevin FitzPatrick, Chief Marketing Officer at Ruby Tuesday. “Toast gives us the technology to enhance the guest experience as we position the brand for the future. We’re excited to leverage these tools to build on what we do best: serving uncompromisingly fresh meals and enjoyable experiences that keep our guests coming back.”


“Ruby Tuesday has spent more than fifty years offering genuine hospitality to its customers,” said Kelly Esten, Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Operating Officer of Enterprise at Toast. “At Toast, we’re proud to deliver that same level of support to a legacy brand like Ruby Tuesday, giving them technology that is as dependable as the quality, passion, and pride that they offer to their guests.”


Toast currently serves hundreds of multi-unit brands, including Caribou Coffee, Choice Hotels, Potbelly Sandwich Shop, Craveworthy Brands, Perkins American Food Co., Nothing Bundt Cakes, Papa Gino's & D'Angelo, and Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill, among others. For more information about Toast and its enterprise capabilities, visit our[Toast for Enterprise page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Frestaurant-pos%2Fenterprise&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+for+Enterprise+page&index=7&md5=222d141eca57944a0b174745755e3bfe) .

**About Toast**


Toast \[NYSE: TOST\] is a global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses. From the busiest local restaurants and shops to large hospitality brands, Toast helps owners and operators manage their businesses more efficiently, drive guest demand, and build lasting success.


Toast integrates software, agentic AI, payments, financial technology solutions, and hardware with a broad partner ecosystem. Powering billions of purchases throughout local commerce, Toast delivers the precision and innovation required for modern restaurant and retail environments. For more information, visit[www.toasttab.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.toasttab.com&esheet=54635715&newsitemid=20261105327388&lan=en-US&anchor=www.toasttab.com&index=8&md5=b4f169be68541bb60a42e2ff5c4ea59c) .


**About Ruby Tuesday**


Founded in 1972, Ruby Tuesday is a leading casual American bar and grill chain known for its broad menu and warm, welcoming atmosphere. With a focus on fresh ingredients, quality, and value, Ruby Tuesday offers a wide variety of guest favorites from handcrafted burgers and slow-cooked ribs to seafood and its signature Garden Bar. With locations across the U.S., Ruby Tuesday continues to deliver classic American comfort food with gracious hospitality at the center of every experience.
